author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time I dive a bit more into Discord, it's ties to Palantir through their use of Persona. Persona is an "experiment" to verify your age and it's received funding by the man behind Palantir. Palantir is a global mass surveillance company that is currently trying to capture every bit of our information. How are these groups connected? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Discord Is Tied To Palantir And It's Really Bad...
